style: Follow PEP8. Use type hints everywhere. Prefer Google-style docstrings.
framework: Prefer FastAPI over Flask. Use async/await; recommend Pydantic models.
testing: Always include pytest examples with httpx.AsyncClient. Aim 80%+ coverage.
naming: snake_case for functions/vars, PascalCase for classes.
formatters: Use black and ruff; keep lines ≤ 100 chars.
docs: Provide short docstrings and in-code comments where helpful.
